mapper.select: SELECT member_id, login_id, email, member_name, birth_date, gender, role, member_status, created_at, withdrawn_at FROM member WHERE role != 'ADMIN' ORDER BY member_id DESC
SELECT member_status FROM member WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND role != 'ADMIN'
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET login_id = NULL, password = NULL, email = NULL, member_name = NULL, birth_date = NULL, gender = NULL, member_status = 'WITHDRAWN', withdrawn_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND role != 'ADMIN' AND member_status != 'WITHDRAWN'
mapper.select: SELECT sp.progress_id, sp.member_id, sp.scenario_id, s.scenario_title, sp.step_id, CASE WHEN sp.progress_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN '최종 단계 (완료)' ELSE COALESCE(ss.step_title, '시작 단계') END AS step_title, CASE WHEN sp.progress_status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 100 WHEN ss.step_order IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((ss.step_order / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scenario_step st WHERE st.scenario_id = sp.scenario_id AND st.step_order > 0)) * 100) END AS progress_rate, sp.progress_status, sp.started_at, sp.last_saved_at, sp.completed_at, CASE WHEN sp.progress_status = 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN DATE_ADD(sp.last_saved_at, INTERVAL 30 DAY) ELSE NULL END AS expire_date FROM simulation_progress sp JOIN member m ON sp.member_id = m.member_id JOIN scenario s ON sp.scenario_id = s.scenario_id LEFT JOIN scenario_step ss ON sp.step_id = ss.step_id WHERE sp.member_id = #{memberId} AND m.member_status != 'WITHDRAWN' AND sp.progress_status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY sp.scenario_id ASC, sp.progress_id DESC
